desc: convert an Atari Degas .pc1 into a PPM image
r: pc1toppm - convert an Atari Degas .pc1 into a PPM image

This program is part of Netpbm(1).

pc1toppm reads an Atari Degas .pc1 file as input and produces a PPM image as output.

The .pc1 format is a compressed (run length encoded) variation on .pi1.

There are no command line options defined specifically for pc1toppm, but it recognizes the options common to all programs based on libnetpbm (See
Common Options .)
